children: South Africa's 2026 maize harvest is expected to be the country's largest on record, the government's Crop Estimates Committee (CEC) said on Thursday, raising its forecast by 6.19% from last year.

The CEC's final summer crop forecast estimated the 2026 maize harvest at 17.76 million metric tons, up from 16.725 million metric tons harvested the season before. The last estimate, on October 27, had put the 2026 harvest at 17.69 million tons.
The harvest is expected to consist of 9.85 million metric tons of white maize, for human consumption, and 7.91 million tons of yellow maize, used mainly in animal feed.
